newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt interbank market stagnant in holiday season.
newsitem.headline: Egypt interbank market stagnant in holiday season.

text.p: Private-sector bankers said there were very few interbank deals on the Egyptian pound on Thursday because of week end liquidity and the looming New Year holidays.
One banker said he made one overnight deal at 9-3/4 percent and another quoted the same figure for the one weekly trade he made.
Bankers on Wednesday quoted an overnight range of between 9-7/8 and 10-1/4 percent and put their weekly rates at 10 and 10-3/8 percent.
State-owned banks maintained their minimum overnight lending rate at 10-1/2 percent, bankers said.
